name: Blue Water Acquisition Corp. III
summary: Blue Water Acquisition Corp. III does not have significant operations. The company focuses on effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or other similar business combination with one or more businesses. It intends to target businesses in the artificial intelligence, biotechnology, healthcare, and technology sectors. Blue Water Acquisition Corp. III was incorporated in 2024 and is based in Mountainside, New Jersey.
